note: The frozen half of the task. Nothing a submission says may move any number in this file. The verifier reads its own copy of it at grading time, and tests/Dockerfile refuses to build unless the two copies are byte-identical.

budget.note: The training run is FROZEN and identical for every submission. A submission does not train anything and cannot change a single forward or backward pass; it chooses which of the snapshots that run produced to keep, and how to combine them.

training_recipe.note: FROZEN. Stated here in full so the run that produces the snapshots is reproducible on the agent surface with environment/train_local.py. The learning rate is CONSTANT and is never decayed: that is the property that makes the last iterate a noisy point in a basin rather than the bottom of one, and it is the reason a combination of snapshots can be worth more than the final snapshot.

snapshots.note: Snapshot i is the parameter state immediately after optimizer step i * every_steps. Snapshot 16 is the final state of the run. The ids are the whole namespace a selection may refer to.
snapshots.storage_budget_note: The retention budget. At most 6 of the 16 snapshots may be KEPT, which is what makes this a selection problem rather than an averaging identity. Keeping all sixteen is not an available answer.

init.note: The frozen initialisation. The verifier's training run starts from these tensors on every grading pass.

evaluation.metric: mean token-level cross-entropy in nats, lower is better
evaluation.note: The graded split is NOT in the agent image. environment/data/devset_slice.bin is a proxy cut from a different FineWeb training shard and is the agent's own yardstick. The snapshot ranking the agent measures on the devset and the ranking the verifier measures on its held-out split are NOT the same ranking, and closing that gap is the task.

data.format: FineWeb10B GPT-2 BPE. 1024-byte int32 header (magic 20240520, version 1, token count), then uint16 token ids.
data.train_slice_note: Exactly the 50331648 tokens the frozen run consumes, plus one for the shifted target.
